body.focus: Bug: node:test runs hang indefinitely after all sub-tests finish because no exit-forcing flag is set. The repo's three node-test-runner invocations (package.json:19, packages/project-memory/package.json:27, vscode-plugin/package.json:911) invoke node's built-in test runner with no exit-forcing flag. Some shared test fixture leaves a timer/socket/watcher open after tests finish, so the process never exits on its own. Fix: add the `--test-force-exit` flag to the node test-runner invocation in all three 'test' scripts, so a run exits promptly once all tests have genuinely finished. No test logic changes. See ISSUE-cffd1c931403f0c9 for the full record.
